title: Deployment QA wait and connection recovery
summary: The driver polls a cheap QA fingerprint, dispatches on changed facts and once at the deadline, and preserves its last blocker result while unchanged. A closed database connection or failed actor database lookup pauses resumably. Restore connectivity, inspect the same run and capture, then re-drive it. Mission executions name walking until all mission walk-end receipts are recorded, then awaiting_walk_review; both preserve the pending bundle and no verdict is implied.
